taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Cichorium intybus, plant_name_id 2901597 (Library 1.0 candidate r2).

growth_form.note: FNA vol. 19: a perennial herb with a basal rosette and branched flowering stems.

growth.note: Grown four years, as a perennial herb flowers from its second.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the species grows in disturbed open sites (FNA).

allometry.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2901597): usual height 0.3-1.2 m; the middle at three years.

traits.life_span.note: FNA vol. 19, Cichorium intybus: perennials (sometimes flowering the first year).

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2901597): 0.3-1.2 m; FNA gives no height for the species.

traits.height_max_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2901597).

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: FNA vol. 19, Cichorium: leaves basal and cauline, alternate.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: FNA vol. 19, Cichorium intybus: blades of basal leaves 5-35+ cm long.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: FNA vol. 19, Cichorium intybus: blades of basal leaves 1-8(-12+) cm wide.

traits.leaf_shape.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2901597): oblanceolate basal blades.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2901597): dentate.

traits.leaf_incision.note: Basal leaves pinnately lobed (runcinate) in some flowering photographs and merely toothed in others (batch pilot-asteraceae-2026-10-31c).

traits.division_pattern.note: The lobes of the lobed basal leaves are pinnate, along the midrib (batch pilot-asteraceae-2026-10-31c).

traits.inflorescence.note: FNA vol. 19, Cichorium: heads mostly in axillary, nearly sessile glomerules, some borne singly on elongate peduncles; drawn as single heads at the nodes and tips.

traits.flowering_position.note: FNA vol. 19, Cichorium: heads axillary along the branches and at their tips.

traits.ligulate_colour.note: FNA vol. 19: corollas usually blue, sometimes pink or white. Median colour of the blue petal pixels in six close-up photographs (observations 283894255, 722265102, 734839792, 29255340, 147562047, 30308946): sRGB [157, 157, 232].

traits.flowering_months.note: FNA vol. 19 gives Apr-Jul; the drafted facts (species-facts-2026-10-15, L2901597) Jun-Oct; flowering photographs from the northern hemisphere are dated May to November, most June to September (batch pilot-asteraceae-2026-10-31c). Apr-Oct covers the flora and the photographs.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: FNA vol. 19, Cichorium intybus: cypselae 2-3 mm.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2901597): fruit Aug-Oct.

sources.title: Flora of North America vol. 19 (eFloras), drafted species facts of 2026-10-15, and iNaturalist photographs

provenance.notes: Added in the daisy-family pilot of 2026-10-31 (plantgen-claude project-files/roadmap/pilot-asteraceae/): every character from FNA, the drafted facts or measured photographs, drawn by the rules its taxa hold.
